reviews.text:
We just finished our second pool build with Southernwind Pools, and once again, they exceeded our expectations! After moving out to the country, we weren’t sure if they would take on our project, and we are so grateful they did.

From start to finish, the entire process was incredibly smooth—honestly even more streamlined than our first build with them back in 2019. The process was professionally done from start to finish. The pool build was completed in under seven weeks, which was such a pleasant surprise.

The design phase with Clay was just as impressive. He truly listened to our wants and must-haves and turned them into a design that fits our family and our property perfectly. Never hesitated to make small changes (after we had time to overthink things) until it was perfect.

John managed the project and did an outstanding job. His communication was clear, consistent, and timely, and he kept the scheduling of all the trades moving without a hitch.

We couldn’t be happier with our experience and highly recommend Southernwind Pools to anyone considering a build—whether it’s your first time or your second!
reviews.author: Jennifer Corwin

reviews.text: Our experience with Southernwind Pools, and especially Clay Wager, has been nothing short of exceptional. We recently completed a major backyard renovation in Dallas with a large pool, outdoor living area, and outdoor kitchen. Southernwind managed the project with the expertise you’d expect from a large, experienced company, but with the relationships you’d expect from a small, family-owned business. Our project designer, Clay Wager, did much more than design our project. He worked with us to create what we wanted and needed as a family. As first-time pool owners, he both listened and provided expert advice. Additionally, he was present for us throughout the entire project. When we noticed a chip in a tile, he was the one we called and quickly had it fixed under the outstanding warranty Southerwind provides. Any large construction project is going to have its glitches along the way, but I’m glad we had Clay to move the process along. Perhaps most importantly, we believe the project is now perfect. After using it for a summer, it was exactly what we wanted, and all our guests have been highly impressed with it. The project took a while to complete, but Southernwind completed our backyard within budget and with minimal inconvenience to our family. I would highly recommend Southernwind Pools to anyone looking to renovate their backyard.
reviews.author: Christopher Salinas

reviews.text: This is the second time we have used Southernwind to build a pool and we had a wonderful experience again! Southernwind focuses on building less pools than many of the pool builders in DFW, but each one of their pools is custom and high quality. This was one of our requirements for a builder. We worked with Clay on design and David was our project manager. Clay provided the unique design we were looking for to make our backyard stand out. Once the project was handed over to David he built the whole thing in 8 weeks from dig to plaster! One thing that really stands out to me is how well they communicate throughout each stage of the project. Communication was one of my main requirements and they exceeded my expectations. Overall I would highly recommend Southernwind for any pool project.
reviews.author: David Vinson

reviews.text: Great options for the homeowner to choose between stone, counters, turf, etc. They ensured final punch list was completed to our liking and approval. Finished project looks great and now we've extended our living area outside.
reviews.author: Bill Hubble

reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience with Southernwind Pools from start to finish. Adam was our designer, and he created the most beautiful pool for our backyard. He really listened to what was important to us and designed a pool that not only met—but exceeded—our expectations. Our backyard is absolutely stunning now!
If we ever move within the Dallas area, there's no question—we will 100% work with Adam and Southernwind Pools again. In fact, some of our neighbors also used Adam and Southernwind, and their backyard looks incredible too!
Adam also connected us with fantastic landscaping contacts, and we couldn't be happier with the results. Charlie was our project manager and did a great job keeping everything on track. He was consistently checking in and always available to answer questions or explain details.
Both Adam and Charlie were professional, responsive, and a pleasure to work with. We truly couldn’t have asked for a better experience or a more perfect pool. We love it!
reviews.author: Dallas McCutchan

reviews.text: I can't say enough great things about our experience with Southernwind Pools. We absolutely LOVE our dream back yard!!! You can get a very basic pool from any of the big name companies around here, but my husband and I wanted something modern and unique. Our designer Clay Wager had an incredible eye for design and helped completely transform what we thought was possible in our yard. We do not plan to move, but if we ever did, there's no doubt in my mind we'd be calling up Clay and team to design any future pools/outdoor spaces.
reviews.author: Jennifer Cortez

reviews.text: Great experience with Clay and the entire crew at Southernwind Pools.  They were easy to communicate with and stayed on schedule.  I highly recommend Southernwind Pools.
reviews.author: Lisa Day

reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier with our new pool.  The Southernwind team was professional, communicative, and easy to work with.  The final result exceeded our expectations.  Our backyard has already become a favorite spot for our family.  Highly recommend to anyone considering building a pool!
reviews.author: Robby Markose
